|strategy=By Royce Russell, Gold 15<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20001011182145id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/dutch.html</ref>

[[Dutch]] is a great mainstay for any deck. Many people have chosen not to use him anymore in favor of the more recent, higher power characters.

The best thing about [[Dutch]] is his low deploy cost of 2 and his high forfeit of 5! Say you're buiding a cheap deploy deck, [[Dutch]] is your man. He adds +1 forfeit to every other Gold Squadron pilot at the same site or system! The most powerful part of this card is his ability to draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise if he is piloting his ship [[Gold 1]].

Combos:

[[Dutch]] + [[Pops]] + [[Tiree]] - With this combo at a site you have a power of 6 with a total forfeit of 15!! All this for just 6 Force, what a deal!

[[Dutch]] + [[Gold 1]] - alone at a system he draws one destiny if not able to otherwise, if you draw a 6 you would have a power of 10, forfeit of 8, all for just 3 Force, wow!!

[[Dutch]] + [[Tiree]] + [[Gold 2]] - this little combo gives you a power 6 ship with a maneuver of 5 and forfeit of 13! Use it with your [[Death Star]] destruction deck and it adds one to your [[Attack Run]] total!

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-dutch-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Dutch (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (8 March 2016): Same words as the previous version. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a white italic “E” at the lower right. The slip replaces the full card image.

Lower part of the previous card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
